scenarios.name: Product Types and Hierarchy Traversal
scenarios.description: Verify product discovery by exploring catalog product types, retrieving product lists for a given type, examining individual product details, and navigating location-specific products.

scenarios.name: Product Location Discovery and Filtered Search
scenarios.description: Discover product locations, inspect available types at a location, search product collections using specific query filters, and verify detailed content.

scenarios.name: Products Validation and Boundary Negative Checks
scenarios.description: Verify appropriate error handling for invalid product IDs, non-existent product types, and out-of-range pagination limits.

scenarios.name: Active Alerts Discovery and Regional Aggregations
scenarios.description: Verifies metadata discovery of alert types and active counts, followed by queries filtered by regional partitions including active alerts list, area, zone, and marine/land region.

scenarios.name: Alerts Catalog Query and Item Deep-Dive Flow
scenarios.description: Queries the global alerts catalog with pagination parameters, captures a resulting alert identifier, and fetches its single-resource detail representation.

scenarios.name: Alerts Boundary Parameter Validation and Resource Handling
scenarios.description: Verifies API input validation for malformed temporal query parameters, nonexistent alert identifiers, and invalid zone identifiers.

scenarios.name: Center Weather Advisory Flow
scenarios.description: Inspect Center Weather Service Unit metadata and retrieve CWA advisories and details.

scenarios.name: Aviation SIGMET Navigation Flow
scenarios.description: Query SIGMETs globally and progressively drill down by ATSU identifier, date, and timestamp.

scenarios.name: Aviation Invalid Identifiers Boundary Negative Tests
scenarios.description: Validate that non-existent unit IDs and invalid date formats return appropriate client error status codes.

scenarios.name: Station Observation Discovery and Detailed Telemetry Flow
scenarios.description: Discovers active weather stations, fetches station metadata, inspects latest observation, and drills down into observation time series records.

scenarios.name: Station Aviation Terminal Aerodrome Forecast (TAF) Flow
scenarios.description: Verifies retrieval of aviation TAF forecasts and specific timestamped TAF reports for a major airport station.

scenarios.name: Station Boundary and Negative Input Validation
scenarios.description: Tests system boundaries by providing invalid station identifiers, out-of-range pagination limits, and malformed observation timestamps.

scenarios.name: Radar Infrastructure and Station Telemetry End-to-End Flow
scenarios.description: Discovers radar servers and stations, inspecting server topology, station metadata, active alarms, profiler data, and host queue statistics.

scenarios.name: Radar Parameter Boundary and Missing Entity Validation
scenarios.description: Verifies that invalid station codes, malformed time intervals, and missing servers produce appropriate 400 and 404 client error responses.

scenarios.name: Auxiliary Office Headlines and Forecast Zones E2E Workflow
scenarios.description: Verifies retrieval of weather forecast offices, active office headlines, and traverses zone lists, type classifications, specific zone metadata, forecasts, observations, and monitoring stations.

scenarios.name: Auxiliary Weather Reference, Gridpoint Forecasts, and Point Stations E2E
scenarios.description: Verifies meteorological glossary references, gridpoint forecast models (standard, hourly, stations), icon definitions, and point coordinate spatial lookups.

scenarios.name: Auxiliary Resource Negative and Boundary Validation
scenarios.description: Validates appropriate 404 client error handling for invalid or non-existent weather icons, dual condition blends, satellite thumbnail areas, and office headlines.

scenarios.name: Security: Verify Endpoint Authentication and Headers
scenarios.description: Tests that requests with missing credentials or malformed security headers are rejected appropriately.

scenarios.name: Idempotency: Verify Repeated Safe Requests
scenarios.description: Executes identical requests to verify that safe operations produce identical, idempotent responses.
